entity: SpaceX sites' injury rate vs their industry, 2025 and prior years
what_we_add: the company-wide 3.2x for 2025 (third straight year) and the Ford 11.4 vs GM/Honda/Tesla/Toyota comparison, about 1.9x - no source has the Ford leg at all
why: Texas Observer (2025 data), TechCrunch (2024) and Reuters via Engadget (2022) all name SpaceX and report the same finding, same direction: injury rates several times the industry average, persisting for years. Their 5-6x figures are Starbase-only, a different scope than our all-sites 3.2x, so no contradiction.
